Switch back installs the held root as it was
Authority installs the switch back on any head
Pin does not hold the root
Swap proposes before recording its roots
replace:
root |-> new]
        /\ swap' = s
        /\ file' = [file EXCEPT !.swap = s]

root |-> new]
        /\ swap' = s
        /\ UNCHANGED file

name: Recovery trusts the file over the head
Build reads the head instead of the pin
A crash keeps the write turn
Resume forgets the pages before the position
Switch-back round keeps the content it reflected
Switch-back round applies only additions
replace:
items |-> Apply(swap.old.items, swap.new.items,
                                        head.items)],
items |-> swap.old.items \cup (head.items \ swap.new.items)],

name: Switch-back round records only the old root
replace:
/\ file' = [file EXCEPT !.swap = s]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<head, history, commits, crashes, faulty, phase, turn, pin,
                 cursor, built, base, cand, held>>

/\ file' = [file EXCEPT !.swap.old = s.old]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<head, history, commits, crashes, faulty, phase, turn, pin,
                 cursor, built, base, cand, held>>

name: A stop releases the hold
replace:
/\ file' = [file EXCEPT !.stage = "stopped"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<head, history, commits, crashes, faulty, turn, pin, cursor,
                 built, base, cand, swap, held>>

/\ file' = [file EXCEPT !.stage = "stopped"]
  /\ held' = FALSE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<head, history, commits, crashes, faulty, turn, pin, cursor,
                 built, base, cand, swap>>
